nodes.name: index.html
nodes.summary: Provides the Vite application's HTML shell, SEO and theme metadata, hosted font connections, React root element, and module bootstrap for the TypeScript entry point.
nodes.languageNotes: Loads the React application through a module script and preconnects to Google Fonts for Inter, JetBrains Mono, and Space Grotesk.

nodes.name: package.json
nodes.summary: Defines the private React frontend package, Vite development and production scripts, Vitest checks, TypeScript validation, and runtime and build dependencies.
nodes.languageNotes: The check script composes TypeScript linting, the Vitest suite, and a full production build as one local verification command.

nodes.name: tsconfig.json
nodes.summary: Configures strict, no-emit TypeScript compilation for React source and tests using ES2020, bundler module resolution, JSON modules, and Vitest globals.
nodes.languageNotes: Uses project references for the Node-side Vite configuration while keeping browser application compilation isolated and emit-free.

nodes.name: tsconfig.node.json
nodes.summary: Defines the composite TypeScript project used to compile the Node-executed Vite configuration with strict ES module and bundler resolution settings.
